description: Crop an existing video to a rectangular region or centered percentage crop and render a new output file. The source video is read only; x/y default to a centered crop when omitted.

crop_percent.description: Centered crop percentage of original dimensions, such as 50 for the center 50%.
crop_percent.title: Crop Percent

height.description: Crop region height in pixels. Pair with width unless using crop_percent.
height.title: Height

input_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
input_path.title: Input Path

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

width.description: Crop region width in pixels. Pair with height unless using crop_percent.
width.title: Width

x.description: Optional X offset in pixels. Defaults to a centered crop when omitted.
x.title: X

y.description: Optional Y offset in pixels. Defaults to a centered crop when omitted.
y.title: Y

name: video_crop
title: Crop video frame
